inputs.goal: 12 onboarding interviews, on why trial users stall at step 3

shards: Participants consistently mention unclear instructions for step 3, with 7/12 citing confusion about required actions
Users report technical difficulties with the step 3 interface, noted by 5/12 participants during interviews
Lack of progress indicators leads to uncertainty about completion status, mentioned by 8/12 participants
Time constraints prevent users from fully engaging with step 3, identified by 6/12 interviewees
Participants express frustration with step 3's complexity compared to initial onboarding steps, cited by 9/12 users
